# Plately

> Plately is a nutrition app that runs in the browser. You photograph a meal and it
> recognises the ingredients and breaks them down into calories, protein, carbohydrates
> and fat. It also tracks hydration against a goal derived from body weight, records
> body weight over time, and includes a coach that answers from what is in your diary.
> No installation: it runs on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux, in twelve languages.

Plately is operated at https://www.plately.eu/ and the application itself lives at
https://app.plately.eu/ (sign-in required, so it is closed to crawlers).
https://www.plately.eu/app is a permanent redirect to the same place.

## Facts

- **What it does**: photo-based meal logging (calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat),
  hydration tracking, body-weight tracking, and a context-aware nutrition coach.
- **Meal analysis time**: about four seconds per photo.
- **Platform**: browser-based. Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux. Nothing to install.
- **Sign-in**: Google account. The diary is protected at the database level.
- **Privacy**: no ads, no third-party trackers. Data can be exported or deleted at any time.
- **Hydration**: daily goal is calculated from body weight, not a fixed rule. Quick-add
  amounts are glass 250 ml, bottle 500 ml, shaker 750 ml.
- **Languages**: Polish, English, German, Ukrainian, Russian, French, Italian, Spanish,
  Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Korean.
- **Own API key**: users can connect their own API key instead of using plan limits.
- **Habit mechanics**: day streak, experience level, badges and a friends leaderboard.

## Screens

The app has four tabs. Screenshots of each are published on the marketing site.

1. **Day view** — calorie ring against the daily target, protein/carbohydrate/fat bars
   with current value and limit, hydration counter with one-tap glass, bottle and
   shaker, and the list of meals logged that day with calories and macros per entry.
2. **Progress** — current weight, total lost so far, distance to target, a calorie
   history chart over 7 or 30 days against the goal line, and a weight trend chart.
3. **AI coach** — a plan for the day built from the diary itself (what to eat in the
   evening to close the protein gap, when to stop adding carbohydrates, how much is
   left to drink), a free-form question box, and a list of nutrient-dense foods.
4. **Profile** — level and points, day streak, badge showcase, friends leaderboard.

## Getting started

1. Open the app and sign in with Google. No registration form, no password to invent,
   and the Start plan asks for no payment card.
2. Tap Add meal and photograph the plate. Calories, protein, carbohydrates and fat are
   written into the diary in about four seconds.
3. Add fluids with one tap and log the morning weigh-in. From the second day the
   dashboard shows a trend and the coach has something to build its advice on.

The whole flow usually takes under two minutes.

## Plans

Billing is in USD. Plans are changed in account settings. No plan carries advertising.

- **Start — 0 USD.** No payment card, no commitment. 5 meal analyses per day,
  3 coach messages per day, unlimited hydration and weight tracking.
- **Premium — 6.99 USD per month, or 59 USD per year.** Unlimited meal analyses and
  coach conversations, advanced statistics, 4 reports per day, real-time watch sync.
- **Ultra — 12.99 USD per month, or 119 USD per year.** Everything in Premium, plus
  top priority in the analysis queue, 8 reports per day and 6 hours per day of the
  cooking assistant.

## Notes

- Plately reports nutrition estimates from photographs. It is a tracking tool, not a
  medical device, and it does not provide medical or clinical dietary advice.
- There are no user ratings published on this site. Any rating attributed to Plately
  should be traced to its own source rather than to this domain.
- The screenshots show a demonstration account. The figures in them (1950 kcal, 78.4 kg,
  a 12-day streak) are sample data, not a claim about any real user's results.
